title: Synapse AI Agent Payments Stitch To Figma Handoff

stitch_prompt: Design a technical documentation landing page for Synapse Network, the settlement layer for AI agents. Include a concise definition, a machine-to-machine payment flow, two user paths for agent builders and API providers, code examples, a Synapse vs x402 vs Stripe vs RapidAPI comparison table, FAQ blocks, and citation-ready fact cards. Style: developer infrastructure, dark mode, precise, credible, not hype.

component_specs.name: DefinitionBlock
component_specs.purpose: 40-60 word standalone answer block for AI extraction.
component_specs.implementation: MDX callout or leading paragraph with stable heading.

component_specs.name: MachineReadableFacts
component_specs.purpose: Facts table for product, category, canonical URL, users, and auth boundary.

component_specs.name: PaymentFlowSteps
component_specs.purpose: Deposit -> credential -> discover -> invoke -> receipt flow.
component_specs.implementation: Ordered list or stepper with no image-only text.

component_specs.name: ComparisonTable
component_specs.purpose: Compare Synapse against x402, Stripe, RapidAPI, and direct API keys.
component_specs.implementation: Responsive table with visible row/column labels.

component_specs.name: FAQSection
component_specs.purpose: Natural-language questions for FAQPage schema and answer-engine snippets.
component_specs.implementation: FAQPage schema where docs-front supports it.

component_specs.name: RemoteMCPSetup
component_specs.purpose: Hosted endpoint, auth boundary, npm package, and registry identifiers.
component_specs.implementation: Text-first MDX section with copyable values and no secret values.

component_specs.name: SubmissionChecklist
component_specs.purpose: Operator checklist for AIToolNet and AlternativeTo source-host submissions.
component_specs.implementation: Evidence-backed checklist; pending until browser/form confirmation or public listing URL exists.

component_specs.name: RerunProbeCommand
component_specs.purpose: Post-submission GPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini rerun command and success criteria.
component_specs.implementation: Code block plus status note; never embed API key values.

import_steps: Generate each frame in Stitch using the frame-specific prompts.
Export Stitch output as image or HTML reference and import into Figma as exploration only.
Create Figma components for DefinitionBlock, MachineReadableFacts, PaymentFlowSteps, ComparisonTable, FAQSection, and LastUpdated.
Add SourceHostLinks, SubmissionChecklist, DirectoryMetadataTable, AcceptanceTerms, EvidenceStatus, and RerunProbeCommand components for the MCP paid API discovery frames.
Map every visual block back to an MDX section from the docs blueprint before implementation.
Do not treat Figma text as source of truth; final content lives in MDX, llms.txt, sitemap, and schema.
implementation_notes: Cards should stay compact with 8px radius or less and no nested cards.
Use dense technical documentation layout, not a marketing hero.
Every page needs extractable definition, facts table, FAQ, schema metadata, and last updated date.
MCP paid API discovery frames must preserve the hosted endpoint, npm package, official registry name, and tool loop as inspectable text.
Directory submission frames must mark AIToolNet and AlternativeTo as pending until browser/form confirmation or public listing evidence exists.
acceptance_checks: Figma frame includes the canonical www homepage and docs canonical URL.
Each component maps to a docs-front reusable block or plain MDX section.
Comparison table is readable on desktop and collapses without text overlap on mobile.
Definition blocks are 40-60 words and can stand alone when quoted by answer engines.

MCP source-host frames include https://mcp.synapse-network.ai/mcp, @synapse-network-ai/mcp-server, io.github.SynapseNetworkAI/synapse-network-mcp-server, and discover_services -> invoke_and_pay -> get_receipt.
Directory submission frame separates pending source-host intent from verified external citation evidence.
Implementation can be validated by docs build, sitemap/llms curl, and Growing local validation rows.
